note: Per-frame pose scripts for Akaza's v3 redraw (same conventions as tools/art_v3/poses/tanjiro.json). Frame counts, phase breaks and timing semantics match the shipped atlas; new clips (rensho_2, manyo, ryusen, step_punch, air_kushiki, air_land, hiyu_senrin) carry theirs in "new". He fights bare-handed in a brawler guard (input image 1: both navy hands raised in front of his chest as half-closed claws, elbows out, torso leaning slightly forward, a confident grin); the edit defaults change only his arms and hands (spec prompt.edit_keep / edit_change). Every clip uses wide 768x1024 columns: the wide guard and his straight punches do not fit a 512 column. The idle is warped from the approved key (spec/akaza-idle-rig.json); round_intro and awakening_start are assembled by intro_warp.py from helper key edits (intro_keys, awaken_keys). guard_low is an edit of the crouch's last drawing (references/crouch-key.png), registered on crouch frame 5. "stance": clips that keep the guard's height (QA band vs the idle); attacks are not banded, a lunge is meant to be lower; "upright_frames" stand fully upright.

walk.intro: In-place forward walk cycle in his brawler guard: knees slightly bent, both navy hands kept raised in front of his chest as half-closed claws, elbows out, torso leaning slightly forward, a confident grin, eyes on the opponent. A heavy, prowling step; the top of his head stays within about 5 percent of input image 1 (he never stands fully upright). The guard and the head stay steady (at most 8 px of bob); the pelvis stays at the same X in every frame. It is a seamless loop, not a story of moving right.
frames: Contact: the near leg reaches forward RIGHT with the heel touching the ground, the far leg behind on the ball of its foot; the wide white trousers billow with the stride; guard held.
Weight: weight moves onto the near foot, both knees bend a little more, the far heel lifts; the sash ends swing back.
Passing: the far foot travels forward close to the ground under the pelvis, the near leg supports; body at its highest (still knees bent).
Opposite contact: the far leg now forward RIGHT with the heel down, the near leg behind on the ball of its foot (the legs swapped compared with frame 1); guard held.
Opposite weight: weight onto the far foot, knees bend a little more, the near heel lifts.
Opposite passing: the near foot travels forward under the pelvis, the far leg supports; flows directly into frame 1.

stand_light.intro: Standing light punch (5A): a fast lead-hand jab that starts and ends in the approved brawler guard. He punches with a closed navy fist; no effects.

Chamber: the lead fist drawn a little back beside his chin, elbow tucked, torso coiled, eyes on the target.

Active: a full straight jab: the lead arm fully extended to the RIGHT at shoulder height, the navy fist closed, knuckles forward; torso turned into the punch; the rear claw guards his chin; front knee bent.
Snap: the arm still fully extended at shoulder height, the body leaning a little further into the punch, the rear hand guarding.
Recovery: the fist pulls back toward his chin, elbow bending, weight returning over the centre.
Return: back in the approved brawler guard, both hands as claws before his chest, almost identical to input image 1.

air_type.intro: Destructive Death: Air Type (236A/C): from the brawler guard he winds his rear arm back and fires one tremendous straight punch into the air in front of him with a lunging step, then returns to guard. Closed navy fist; draw no shockwave or effects, the game adds them.

Active: he steps forward into a deep lunge, front knee bent over the front foot, rear leg stretched back; the rear arm is fully extended straight forward to the RIGHT at shoulder height, navy fist closed; torso turned square into the punch; the lead hand pulled back to his chest.

Active end: still fully extended, the fist at the same height, shoulders beginning to relax.
Recovery: the punching arm pulls back, elbow bending, weight moving back over the centre, the lunge narrowing.
Recovery: both hands coming back up toward the guard, the front foot drawing back to the stance width of input image 1.
Return: back in the approved brawler guard, both hands as claws before his chest, almost identical to input image 1.

Weight moves back onto it, knees bend a little more.
The other foot slides back under the pelvis; flows directly into frame 1.

Never punch with the left arm here.
